Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on your earlier commitments: is story 3 done, is story 4 done, is task 15 done, and is task 19 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you—and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12, the Sandbox gateway timeouts on retry?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your update: finished card tokenisation, shipped the payment status API version two, today you’re adding idempotency keys, and nothing is blocking you.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.
Who can help unblock this once idempotency keys are in so you can pick the summary page back up?
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your update.

task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, is story 5 done, is bug 12 done, is story 2 done, and is task 16 done?

What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, and I will add it to the parking lot, then Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock bug 12, with the sandbox gateway timeouts and access to the platform team’s staging gateway?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I will pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker and your commitment, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya. Admin, is task 14 done after your earlier “finish it tomorrow” commitment?

And is story 1 done after your “continue working on the payment retry story today” commitment, and what did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your update: refund API tests are finished, you’re continuing the payment retry story today, and there are no blockers.

task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slipped because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Who can help unblock this, given the sandbox was down and you’re aiming to finish task 14 tomorrow?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Need the sandbox from the platform team, and your commitment to sync with Maya after the stand-up, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers were raised: one item is on track and will resume after idempotency keys, bug 12 is blocked by sandbox gateway timeouts and needs access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions are waiting on security review, and the sandbox was down so access is needed from the platform team. A side discussion was parked for offline follow-up about the gateway timeouts and configuration. task 19 was not covered, and the owners will get a follow-up about it. Follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who did not respond, are coming in Teams—thank you, everyone.
